description: Regional Bus Patronage is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Number of customers catching regional bus services. In addition to this data, the Translink PT Performance Dashboard provides visual and interactive performance data on patronage, on-time-running, fines and warnings, passenger injuries, and customer experience metrics. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are public transport, qconnect, translink, transport. It offers 20 resource(s) in csv, txt. The portal shows 2023-11-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
